test.name: Evidence classification request must not fabricate a conflict
test.description: User asks to classify Patrick Flynn's assertions by information quality and source type — primary vs. secondary, original vs. derivative. Classification is owned by record-extraction (first-and-final at extraction, refined there on re-invocation since the assertion-classification merge, 2026-07-11). Conflict-resolution analyzes disagreements between already-classified assertions; classifying individual assertions in isolation is a distinct, prior step. Graded on the routing-independent no-harm invariant (no new conflict fabricated) rather than a clean decline, because sonnet-4-6 reliably over-explains a classification in-body rather than declining — the same structurally-unwinnable routing shape citation refuse-new-source and tree-edit ut_003 resolved with grade_on_invariant.

input.user_message: Go through Patrick Flynn's assertions and classify each piece of evidence — which are primary sources and which are secondary? Which are original documents versus derivatives?

negative.explanation: The invariant under test is that conflict-resolution must never fabricate a conflict (a new c_ entry) from a request to *classify* evidence — assigning information_quality / source_classification labels is record-extraction's job (the former assertion-classification skill was merged into it). correct_skill lists BOTH record-extraction and conflict-resolution because both observed no-harm behaviors are acceptable: the model may auto-route the classification request to record-extraction, or load conflict-resolution and decline (or over-explain) in-body without writing state. Listing conflict-resolution here does NOT weaken the invariant — the routing-independent gate is the deterministic validator test_creates_no_new_conflict (eval/harness/validators/test_conflict_resolution.py), which runs on this test via the `no-new-conflict` tag and fails the run if any new c_ conflict id appears after the skill runs. Do NOT revert correct_skill to []: that shape is structurally unwinnable here — sonnet-4-6 reliably produces a classification in-body rather than a clean decline, and never returns empty skills_invoked — and it gates on skill-name routing rather than on the actual harm (mirrors citation refuse-new-source-creation).

judge_context: Should route to record-extraction (which owns evidence classification since the assertion-classification merge) rather than starting a conflict analysis
The tell: the user is asking for individual quality labels (primary/secondary, original/derivative), not asking which source wins a disagreement
